data.name: Subhrajit
data.long_meaning: The name Subhrajit is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘subh’ which means auspicious and ‘raja’ which means king. It is a name that symbolizes royalty, happiness, and good fortune. In Hindu mythology, Subhrajit is the name of the commander of the army of Lord Krishna.
data.spiritual_meaning: Subhrajit is a divine name that signifies the presence of the divine within the individual. It is a name that inspires faith, hope, and a deep sense of spiritual connection.
data.numerology_meaning: Subhrajit is a name with a strong vibration and positive energy. It resonates with the energies of creativity, self-expression, and self-healing.
